mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_like (user_id, post_id, is_deleted, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{postId}, 0, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_deleted = IF(is_deleted = 0, 1, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM post_like WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND post_id = #{postId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_like WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND is_deleted = 0
